sources.summary: In modern architecture , the promenade architecturale stood out as an essential design strategy to realize the principles of functionality, aesthetics, and integration with the urban context. Iconic projects by Le Corbusier , such as Villa Savoye (1929), illustrate this concept by guiding the visitor along an upward path that culminates in the contemplation of the roof garden , an open space where the building dialogues harmoniously with nature. A century later, the concept continues to influence contemporary projects , exploring the relationship between movement and space across various architectural typologies such as houses , museums , libraries , and parks .
